name: DocuSign emails are sent as Green Pointe Capital
description:
Objective: DocuSign emails are sent as Green Pointe Capital.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Read the newest DocuSign email of each kind from the test inbox (read-only).
2. Read the From name and the body sender line.
Expected: From is "Green Pointe Capital via Docusign" and the body names Green Pointe Capital (optionally Inc), never a personal account.
